raw_text: Shadowserver Foundation has sinkholed C2 domains associated with the APT28 campaign targeting Indian diplomatic missions. Our analysis confirms 7 unique C2 domains, 12 IP addresses linked to GRU-operated infrastructure, and victim connections from at least 4 European countries. Domain registration patterns consistent with APT28 operational security practices. Full domain list shared with national CERTs.
